workflowVersion.description: The workflow revision the onboarding is pinned to.

status.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.

allOf.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.
allOf.title: WorkflowStatus

currentStep.description: The step awaiting data; null once the onboarding is terminal.

expiresAt.description: Reserved. Onboardings do not expire yet, so this is always null.

completedAt.description: When the onboarding reached a terminal status; null while it is still running.

rejectionReason.description: Why a connector refused, when a rejection a connector drove ended the onboarding.

allOf.description: Why a connector refused the step's data: the caller exhausted its attempts, the challenge expired or was never issued, or the provider rejected outright.
allOf.title: ConnectorRejectionReason

scores.description: The current value of every score the workflow declares, keyed by score name.

agreementStatus.description: Aggregated over every agreement family the onboarding holds, as the `onboarding_agreement_statuses` view derives it; `not_accepted` when it holds none.

allOf.description: Where an onboarding stands on an agreement family, or on every family it holds: `not_accepted` while there is no accepted version, `outdated` when there is one but a newer version has been published, `current` otherwise. Derived, never stored.
allOf.title: OnboardingAgreementStatus

pendingConnector.description: The connector the onboarding is parked on awaiting a callback; null when it is not waiting for one, and for onboardings parked before this was recorded.

connectorId.description: The id of the connector the onboarding is waiting on.

connectorName.description: The name the workflow step gives that connector declaration.

connectorOrder.description: The order of the connector slot on the step the connector was parked in.

parkedAt.description: When the onboarding was first parked on this connector; null for a row parked before the engine recorded it.

total.description: Rows matching the filters, across all pages.

400.description: The body or query violates its declared shape; `message` names each violated rule.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

401.description: No bearer token, or the token fails signature, issuer, audience or expiry verification.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

403.description: The token verifies but its `roles` claim holds none of `ADMIN_REQUIRED_ROLES`; signing in again cannot fix this.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

503.description: Entra's signing key set could not be reached, so the token was never judged. Retry.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError
